name: Village Oaks Shopping Center
summary: Village Oaks Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination in Live Oak, Texas, offering convenient shopping and dining options along Pat Booker Road. With friendly service and a practical tenant mix, this community-focused center serves the everyday needs of northeast San Antonio residents.
demographics: Village Oaks Shopping Center serves the Live Oak community in northeast San Antonio, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding suburban neighborhoods. The trade area consists of established residential communities with a mix of young families, retirees, and military personnel from nearby Randolph Air Force Base. Shoppers typically seek convenient, everyday services and value-oriented retail options, with frequent visits for groceries, dining, and personal services rather than destination shopping trips.
description: Village Oaks Shopping Center is a neighborhood shopping destination located at 8320 Pat Booker Road in Live Oak, Texas, serving the northeast San Antonio metropolitan area. This convenient retail center provides essential services and dining options to the local community, featuring a practical mix of tenants including a liquor store and Alamo BBQ among other businesses. The center maintains regular operating hours from 9:30 AM to 9:00 PM, making it accessible for both daytime errands and evening visits. With a solid 4.3-star rating from 168 customer reviews, shoppers appreciate the friendly service and great deals available throughout the center, though some note that certain tenants maintain varying hours. The shopping center's location along Pat Booker Road provides easy access for residents of Live Oak and surrounding communities seeking everyday shopping and dining conveniences.
